params.linkText: Germany’s annual inflation rises to 2.9% in August

children: In other parts of Europe, Slovakia’s construction output rose by 2.3% Y/Y in July.
Austria’s industrial production fell by 1.1% Y/Y in July.
Sweden’s total industrial orders fell 0.5% Y/Y in July. Industrial production in Sweden rose by 0.2% Y/Y in July.
The annual inflation rate in Denmark rose to 2% in August.
Industrial production in Finland rose by 4.5% Y/Y in July.
Norway’s annual inflation rate rose to a four-month high of 3.3% in August.
The annual inflation rate in the Czech Republic rose to 1.9% in August.

edged 0.25% lower to 648.3, with focus on ECB decisions, while surging oil prices and renewed inflation concerns added to uncertainty over the outlook for further rate increases. Brent crude remained above $100 a barrel after escalating attacks involving Iran and the U.S. pushed prices through the key threshold on Wednesday.
ECB is expected to raise its key interest rate by 25 basis points, its second hike since the U.S.-Iran war began, while signaling caution over further increases that could weigh on economic activity.
In the bond market, the U.S. bond was down less than 1 basis point to 4.84%.
UK's 10-year yield was down 2 basis points to 5.25%.
Germany's 10-year yield was down 1 basis point to 3.43%.

title: European indexes steady ahead of ECB decision
